svg.text: BED v7 | build order | assembly / installation view
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
All pictured panel IDs are listed in the native
BuildOrder sheet and CutSchedule. This is the
assembled module, not an exploded part detail.
1. Place the 2 head boxes at the wall, 4 side bays in the middle, 2 foot bays at the foot.
2. Level, clamp and bolt neighbouring case panels together; align all tops at 300 mm.
3. Install drawers and adjustable removable retention straps: side 337 mm, foot 450 mm.
4. Pull each drawer fully out and return it. Wheels must track without guide rubbing.
5. Do not load the bed until the final fastening and support arrangement is confirmed.
